title: hermesVPS phase-080 remediation plan provenance payload
description: Structured provenance record for phase-080 (remediate-and-retest, gate 1: plan only). Records the exact intelligence snapshot and assessment artifact used to draft the plan. Validated by hermes-vps-artifacts at registration; referenced artifact IDs/hashes are added to prerequisite_artifacts. A new 040 selection made after this plan was created causes a downstream stale detection.

candidate_id.description: Candidate ID from the selected phase-060 triage payload. Must equal --subject-id and the phase-070 assessment's candidate_id.

finding_id.description: Optional SG-NNN ID. When non-null it must equal proposed_finding.id of the selected phase-070 assessment for candidate_id.

source_commit.description: Full 40-char lowercase hex SHA of the inspected source commit; must equal run.json source.commit

intel_artifact_id.description: Exact ID of the phase-040 vuln-intel artifact used when drafting this plan. Resolved at plan creation; not a floating reference to 'current 040'. A later change to selected_by_phase[040] causes stale detection.

intel_artifact_sha256.description: payload_sha256 of the phase-040 artifact (the vuln-intel record) at plan creation time. Must match the manifest at registration.

assessed_finding_artifact_id.description: Exact ID of the phase-070 artifact whose finding this plan addresses. Resolved at plan creation.

assessed_finding_sha256.description: payload_sha256 of the phase-070 artifact (the finding record) at plan creation time. Must match the manifest at registration.

intel_freshness_at_plan_time.description: Freshness evaluation recorded when the plan was drafted. Preserved immutably; not updated when new 040 evidence is collected.

plan_summary.description: Optional short summary of the remediation plan

gates_not_executed.description: Gates 2-5 require separate explicit authorization. hermesVPS phase 080 implements gate 1 only.
